descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Sales Manager è responsabile della gestione di un team di rappresentanti delle vendite, dell'impostazione degli obiettivi di vendita e della garanzia che il team soddisfi gli obiettivi di performance. Questo ruolo supporta l'esecuzione delle strategie di vendita e fornisce coaching e sviluppo ai membri del team. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di 4+ esperti ai dipendenti di livello superiore. Principali responsabilità Superare e supportare il team di vendita nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Impostare gli obiettivi di vendita e monitorare le metriche delle prestazioni. Rappresentanti di vendita di treni e mentori. Sviluppare e implementare piani di vendita e strategie. Mantenere gli account dei clienti chiave e risolvere le escalation. Collabora con team di marketing e operazioni. Segnala le prestazioni di vendita alla leadership senior. Competenze & Qualifiche Tipicamente una laurea universitaria (o un'esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e 9+ anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante sono minimamente necessari per essere in grado di gestire e coordinare uno o più team di livello di esperti. Esperienza nella gestione del team di vendita. Forte leadership e competenze di coaching. Ottima comunicazione e capacità interpersonali. La competenza nei sistemi CRM e negli strumenti di reporting. Capacità di analizzare i dati e le prestazioni dell'unità. Cosa ti offriamo
• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 settimane per iniziare)
• 12 Vacanze a pagamento aziendali all'anno
• Programma bonus annuale
• Vantaggi medici, dentali e di visione completi
• Azienda pagata a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine, assicurazione sulla vita a pagamento
• 6% 401K o Roth Company Match con gilet immediato
• Contributo della sicurezza del pensionamento a carico della società a seguito di 1 anno di lavoro
• Rimborso di iscrizione/Assistenza educativa
• Rimborso di palestra trimestrale Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees. Key Responsibilities Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets. Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics. Train and mentor sales representatives. Develop and implement sales plans and strategies. Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations. Collaborate with marketing and operations teams. Report sales performance to senior leadership. Skills & Qualifications Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams. Experience in sales team management. Strong leadership and coaching skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools. Ability to analyze data and drive performance. What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Zusammenfassung Der Sales Manager ist für die Verwaltung eines Teams von Vertriebsvertretern verantwortlich, setzt Vertriebsziele fest und stellt sicher, dass das Team Leistungsziele erreicht. Diese Rolle unterstützt die Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien und bietet Teammitgliedern Coaching und Entwicklung. Dieses Job-Profil ist für People Manager von 4+ erfahrenen Mitarbeitern auf Expertenebene bestimmt. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten Betreuen und unterstützen Sie das Vertriebsteam bei der Erreichung von Zielen. Setzen Sie Vertriebsziele und überwachen Sie Leistungsmetriken. Vertretungen von Trainern und Mentoren. Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsplänen und Strategien. Schlüsselkonten verwalten und Eskalationen beheben. Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing- und Betriebsteams. Melden Sie die Verkaufsleistung an Senior Leader. Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen Typischerweise sind ein Hochschulabschluss (oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung) und 9+ Jahre relevante Arbeitserfahrung minimal erforderlich, um ein oder mehrere Expertenteams verwalten und koordinieren zu können. Erfahrung im Vertriebsteammanagement. Starke Führungs- und Coachingfähigkeiten. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Effizienz in CRM-Systemen und Berichtstools. Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren und die Leistung zu steuern. Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 Wochen zu beginnen)
• 12 Unternehmen bezahlte Ferien pro Jahr
• Jährliches Bonusprogramm
• Volle medizinische, dentale und Vision Vorteile
• Unternehmen bezahlt Kurzfristigkeit und langfristige Behinderung, Gesellschaft bezahlte Lebensversicherung
• 6% 401K oder Roth Company Match mit sofortigem Vesting
• Unternehmen bezahlte Pensionssicherung Beiträge nach 1 Jahr der Beschäftigung
• Studienerstattung/Bildungshilfe
• Vierteljährliche Turnhalle Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind verpflichtet, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld anzubieten. Wir sind stolz, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le directeur des ventes est chargé de gérer une équipe de représentants des ventes, de fixer des objectifs de vente et de s'assurer que l'équipe atteint les objectifs de rendement. Ce rôle soutient l'exécution de stratégies de vente et fournit du coaching et du perfectionnement aux membres de l'équipe. Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse aux gestionnaires de ressources humaines de plus de 4 employés expérimentés de niveau expert supérieur. Principales responsabilités Superviser et soutenir l'équipe commerciale pour atteindre les objectifs. Établir des objectifs de vente et surveiller les mesures de rendement. Former et mentorer des représentants commerciaux. Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans et des stratégies de vente. Gérer les comptes clients clés et résoudre les escalades. Collaborer avec les équipes de marketing et d'exploitation. Rapporter le rendement des ventes à la haute direction. Compétences et qualifications En règle générale, un diplôme universitaire (ou une expérience de travail équivalente) et plus de 9 ans d'expérience de travail pertinente sont requis au minimum pour pouvoir gérer et coordonner une ou plusieurs équipes de niveau expert. Expérience dans la gestion de l'équipe de vente. Fortes compétences en leadership et en coaching. Excellente communication et capacités interpersonnelles. Connaissance des systèmes de CRM et des outils de rapport. Capacité d'analyser les données et de conduire les performances. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Temps d'arrêt payé concurrentiel (3 semaines pour commencer)
• 12 jours fériés payés par année
• Programme de bonus annuel
• Avantages médicaux, dentaires et de vision complets
• Société d'assurance-vie payée à court terme et à long terme
• 6% 401K ou Roth Company Match avec Vesting Immédiate
• Cotisations à la sécurité de retraite versées par l'entreprise après 1 an d'emploi
• Remboursement des frais de scolarité/assistance éducative
• Remboursement trimestriel de gymnastique Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities
• Support the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget, providing accurate data and analysis
• Assist in refreshing predictive financial forecasts periodically, ensuring accuracy and relevance
• Help in conducting profitability and performance reporting, providing essential data for decision-making
• Contribute to plan analytics and risk management, assisting in the continuous improvement of financial planning and analysis processes
• Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support business recommendations, under the guidance of senior team members
• Support collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for decision-making
• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, aiding informed purchasing decisions
• Help oversee period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful financial reports and analytics
• Assist in period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough financial tracking and reporting for projects
• Help oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting
• Support the adherence to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting and processes.
• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role
• Comply with relevant QESH regulations Education and experience
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles
• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus Critical success factors
• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software
• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards
• Strong financial acumen
• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders Technical & language skills
• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Proficiency in English What we offer you Medical insurance for self and family Company sponsored transportation facility during week days Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring goods and services required by the organization, including both direct and indirect materials. This role ensures cost-effective purchasing strategies, supplier performance management, and contract administration to support operational efficiency. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. El Especialista en Compras Indirectas será responsable de gestionar el proceso de adquisición de bienes y servicios indirectos, optimizando costos y asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de la empresa. Responsabilidades del Puesto * Identificar, evaluar y seleccionar proveedores para bienes y servicios indirectos (ej. MRO, TI, servicios profesionales, viajes, etc.). * Negociar contratos y acuerdos comerciales con proveedores para obtener las mejores condiciones de precio, calidad y servicio. * Desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores clave. * Gestionar el ciclo de vida de los contratos, incluyendo revisiones, renovaciones y terminaciones. * Colaborar con los departamentos internos para comprender sus necesidades de adquisición y asegurar la disponibilidad oportuna de los bienes y servicios. * Analizar el gasto en compras indirectas e identificar oportunidades de ahorro y eficiencia. * Garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos internos de compras, así como las regulaciones externas aplicables. * Mantener actualizados los sistemas de información de compras y la base de datos de proveedores. * Elaborar reportes de desempeño de proveedores y gasto para la toma de decisiones. Cualificaciones del Puesto * Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Comercio Internacional o campo relacionado. * Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en compras indirectas, preferiblemente en un entorno industrial o manufacturero. * Sólidas habilidades de negociación y comunicación. * Dominio del idioma inglés (oral y escrito) indispensable. * Conocimiento avanzado de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). * Experiencia con sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle o similar) es un plus. * Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo. * Orientación a resultados y habilidades analíticas. * Conocimiento de las leyes de contratación y regulaciones comerciales. What we offer you
• Benefits Over law
• Saving found
• Training
• Christmas bonus over low
• Development plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This role supports organizations of various sizes and is designed for individuals who enjoy hands‑on technical work, clear documentation, and contributing to high‑quality production and repair processes.
As part of the team, you will be responsible for inspecting, and testing products according to engineering specifications.

A key part of the role involves creating Job Books that guide mechanics on the shop floor, as well as producing 2D assembly forms and repair instructions used during mechanical inspections and repair activities. Once repair work is completed, you will be responsible for digitizing the Job Books to ensure accurate, organized records of all work performed.

Day‑to‑day, you will visually and mechanically inspect finished goods, identify and document any defects, and communicate issues to the appropriate teams. You’ll help maintain production and inspection equipment, follow all safety and quality procedures, and assist with basic troubleshooting or maintenance tasks as needed. Collaboration is important in this role, and you will work closely with team members to meet production goals and support continuous improvement.

To succeed, you should bring strong mechanical and technical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort reading and following technical instructions or drawings. A high school diploma is required, and 1–2 years of experience working with turbomachinery is preferred. Familiarity with safety, inspection, and quality standards is helpful, along with good communication and teamwork skills. Just as important is a willingness to learn and grow within a manufacturing environment.

Technical proficiency is essential, particularly with AutoCAD and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with any 2D or 3D modeling tools—such as Blender, Polyworks, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Maya, or 3ds Max—is also valuable and will support your success in creating clear, accurate documentation.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Admin Coordinator is responsible for independently handling administrative tasks and coordinating support activities. This role works autonomously and may guide other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Managing Projects

• Manage the Waterfall Report (backlog) to ensure shipment targets are accurate

• Manage multiple projects/timelines simultaneously, while recognizing dynamic and shifting priorities, and adjusting schedules and deliverables accordingly

• Refine project management tools and leverage to track status

• Attend daily QDIP meeting and report out challenges and/or delays

• Act as the main contact for solids reduction products from pre-PO (supporting sales team) to shipments and everything in between

• Communicate effectively with both internal and external customers

• Understanding of project specifications in order to act as an advocate for customer and JWC

• Drive issues to resolution through creative problem solving, effective communication and holding people accountable

• Define project tasks and resource requirements

• Ensure all projects are delivered on-time, within scope

• Monitor and report on progress of the project to all stakeholders

• Present reports defining project progress, problems and solutions with Order Entry

• Assist customer follow up on outstanding submittals / estimated ship date for waterfall report

• Assist schedule release with customer and production planner

Salary: $70K-75K

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for reviewing plans, technical specifications and drawings to determine JWC product mix recommendation and pricing to be included in proposals. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
· Effectively respond to the requests and requirements of outside sales team and Consulting Engineers to ensure that current and prospective customers are being communicated consistently on all the Company’s product lines.
· Communicates and follows-up with manufacturer’s representative network to provide specifications and technical sales information to influence Consulting Engineers, contractors and end-user customers.
· Reviews technical specifications and customers’ requirements to determine JWC product mix.
· Completes Formal Quotes and Direct Bids as required.
· Works closely with sales managers, Consulting Engineers to quote and provide correct product mix at a profitable price.
· Follows-up with reps and prospective customers on quotation/proposal status.
· Reviews purchase orders and provide feedback to Contract Administration if terms are unclear or if PO is not valid.
· Resolves customer concerns in a timely manner, understands customer’s needs, applications and specifications.
· Works closely with outside sales staff, R&D and Operations in order to prepare timely and accurate proposals.
· Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.
· Perform other duties and special projects as assigned
Education, Experience & Skills:
Required: Associates Degree in a Technical area or 2 years of related experience
Desirable: CSI specification certification
· 1-2+ years with technical sales, Applications Engineering or Sales Engineering in the North American public works industry. Preferably wastewater treatment industry.
· Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as outstanding overall presentation skills.
· Demonstrated ability to perform equipment take-offs from bid packages.
· Demonstrated ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications including basic knowledge of motor control electrical schematics
· Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)
· Highly self-motivated.
· Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.
· Outstanding business etiquette skills.
· Knowledge of products and technologies including current and potential applications.

Salary: $75K -90K

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, testing, and maintenance, and recommending new equipment and systems. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
• Provide technical support to the Sales and Tendering teams throughout the bidding process.
• Review pump selections prepared by the Tendering team to ensure technical compliance and optimization.
• Review and interpret client specifications, particularly for critical or special requirements.
• Coordinate with the Design Responsible (DR) team to obtain additional technical inputs and solutions.
• Interact directly with customers to understand specific application needs and incorporate them into the design layout.
• Liaise with suppliers to resolve technical queries and obtain necessary clarifications.
• Coordinate with other Sulzer legal entities (SPUK, SPDE, SPSZH, SPUSA) to obtain technical support and share expertise.
• Provide technical assistance to the Costing department during the bidding stage.
• Prepare preliminary Pump General Arrangement (GA) drawings for customer submission.
• Estimate “not‑to‑exceed” dimensions based on pump selection and buyout drawings.
• Coordinate with Order Engineering teams (Hydraulics, Bare Pump, Packaging, Instrumentation, Electrical, etc.) to address special or non‑standard requirements.
• Support and collaborate with Operations, Purchase, Sales, and Tendering teams during technical evaluations.
• Proactively support company initiatives that promote safe working practices, environmental protection, and continuous improvement. What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Subsidized cafeteria Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. ​
• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates machines.
• Read and interpret procedures, work orders, and technical drawings to meet specifications.
• Apply knowledge of metals and alloys, including stainless and carbon steels.
• Improves set ups and methods for higher quality and improved cost.
• Operate overhead crane and forklifts safely as directed by Supervisor. Perform other duties as necessary.
• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
• Maintains a safe, neat, and orderly workstation
• Assists in the disassembly, inspection, and re-assembly of pump equipment when required
• Communicate effectively to ensure smooth workflow transitions between team members.
• Support and assist coworkers, including training and collaboration.
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide safety program which includes following all safety policies and procedures
• Supports and cooperates in Sulzer Nuclear Quality Program
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Works overtime as requested
• Operates forklifts, overhead cranes, man lifts, and scissor lifts QUALIFICATIONS:
• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training.
• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in machining.
• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspection.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
• Basic math skills. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro superiore e uno dei principali produttori di pompe al mondo. Sulzer offre una vasta gamma di prodotti per la pompaggio di soluzioni per le industrie di acqua, petrolio e gas, energia e prodotti chimici. A causa della crescita continua, stiamo cercando un ingegnere di sviluppo del prodotto per il Centro tecnologico a Thimister/Belgio. Questa è una fantastica opportunità per voi di concentrarsi sullo sviluppo e la standardizzazione dei prodotti con i nostri team a livello globale. In qualità di Product Development Engineer, ti sarà data l'opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi che vanno dalle attività di progettazione alle attività di valorizzazione del prodotto. Se siete talentuosi Ingegnere meccanico che è entusiasta, auto-motivato e hanno una passione per la produzione di ingegneria di alta qualità, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Vi offriamo compiti interessanti e impegnativi in un ambiente globale e multiculturale. Questa è la tua occasione per unire un'organizzazione leader, contribuendo a un'iniziativa all'avanguardia, e fare un impatto reale sul futuro successo di Sulzer. Posizione: Abbiamo sede a Thimister-Clermont, Belgio. I vostri compiti e le vostre responsabilità principali:
• Responsabile per le attività del progetto di sviluppo del prodotto e per raggiungere gli obiettivi del progetto.
• Attività di progettazione come la creazione di studi di progettazione, assemblaggi master e disegni dettagliati, compresi i relativi calcoli di progettazione.
• Coordinate attività di disegno di design dettagliate a livello globale.
• Standardizzare le caratteristiche di design chiave per la gamma di prodotti.
• Creare e mantenere la documentazione del prodotto come cataloghi di progettazione, curve di prestazione idrauliche, manuali di prodotto e strumenti.
• Utilizzare le tecnologie attuali, sviluppare strumenti e metodi per controllare i progetti.
• Una comunicazione efficace con gli enti di produzione e l'organizzazione globale di Product Management per garantire un approccio collaborativo. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica con 4+ anni di esperienza nel settore
• Fluenza in inglese e francese
• Forte capacità di collaborazione all'interno di un ambiente globale e multiculturale
• Proficienza negli strumenti CAD 2D e 3D (ad esempio NX, SolidWorks)
• Una mentalità orientata al cliente con la capacità di tradurre le esigenze tecniche in soluzioni
• Capacità di comunicazione e coinvolgimento degli stakeholder
• Alto livello di precisione e attenzione
• Opportunità di sviluppo continue, con accesso completo alla piattaforma di apprendimento Sulzer per sostenere la vostra crescita personale e professionale
• 36 giorni di congedo annuale
• Un sistema di assicurazione pensione completa e di gruppo progettato per supportare la vostra sicurezza a lungo termine
• Assicurazione sanitaria privata per voi e la vostra famiglia
• Buoni medici ogni giorno
• Opportunità di sviluppo della carriera globale, con esposizione a progetti internazionali e mobilità attraverso la rete Sulzer

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium. This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities. If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer. Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.
• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.
• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.
• Standardize key design features for the product range.
• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.
• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.
• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience
• Fluency in English and French
• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment
• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)
• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
• High level of accuracy and attention to detail What we offer you
• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth
• 36 days of annual leave
• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security
• Private health insurance for you and your family
• Meal vouchers daily
• Global career development opportunities, with exposure to international projects and mobility across the Sulzer network
• The chance to work in an innovative, agile, and vibrant culture where your ideas and impact truly matter Have a question about the role? Reach out to the Hiring Manager – Claude Mockels or the recruiting team – Stéphanie Piron. We are looking forward to hearing from you! Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. À propos du rôle de Sulzer est un employeur de premier plan et l'un des principaux fabricants de pompes au monde. Sulzer fournit une large gamme de produits pour les solutions de pompage pour les industries de l'eau, du pétrole et du gaz, de l'énergie et des produits chimiques. En raison de la croissance continue, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de développement de produits pour le Centre de technologie à Thimister/Belgique. C'est une occasion fantastique pour vous de vous concentrer sur le développement et la normalisation des produits avec nos équipes à l'échelle mondiale. En tant qu'ingénieur en développement de produits, vous aurez la possibilité de travailler sur des projets innovateurs allant des activités de conception aux activités d'amélioration de produits. Si vous êtes talentueux Ingénieur Mécanique qui est enthousiaste, automotivé et a une passion pour produire une ingénierie de haute qualité, nous aimerions entendre de vous! Nous vous proposons des tâches intéressantes et stimulantes dans un environnement multiculturel mondial. C'est votre chance de rejoindre une organisation de premier plan, de contribuer à une initiative de pointe et d'avoir un impact réel sur le succès futur de Sulzer. Lieu: Nous sommes basés à Thimister-Clermont, Belgique. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Responsable des activités du projet de développement de produits et de la réalisation des objectifs du projet.
• Des activités de conception telles que la création d'études de conception, d'assemblages principaux et de dessins détaillés, y compris des calculs de conception connexes.
• Coordonner les activités de conception détaillées à l'échelle mondiale.
• Normaliser les principales caractéristiques de conception de la gamme de produits.
• Créez et maintenez la documentation des produits tels que les catalogues de conception, les courbes de performance hydraulique, les manuels de produits et les outils.
• Utiliser les technologies actuelles, développer des outils et des méthodes pour contrôler les conceptions.
• Communication efficace avec les entités manufacturières et l'organisation mondiale de gestion des produits pour assurer une approche collaborative. Pour réussir ce rôle, vous aurez besoin :
• d'un diplôme en génie mécanique avec 4 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie ;
• d'une bonne connaissance de l'anglais et du français ;
• de solides compétences en collaboration au sein d'un environnement mondial et multiculturel ;
• d'une maîtrise des outils CAO 2D et 3D (p. ex. NX, SolidWorks) ;
• d'un état d'esprit axé sur le client, capable de traduire les besoins techniques en solutions ;
• d'excellentes compétences en communication et en engagement des parties prenantes ;
• d'un niveau élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Possibilités de développement continu, avec un accès complet à la plate-forme d'apprentissage Sulzer pour soutenir votre croissance personnelle et professionnelle
• 36 jours de congé annuel
• Un régime global de retraite et d'assurance collective conçu pour soutenir votre sécurité à long terme
• Assurance santé privée pour vous et votre famille
• Chèque repas quotidien
• Possibilités de développement de carrière globale, avec une exposition à des projets internationaux et la mobilité à travers le réseau Sulzer
• La chance de travailler dans une culture innovatrice, agile et dynamique où vos idées et vos impacts sont vraiment importants Avez-vous une question sur le rôle? Communiquez avec le responsable de l'embauche – Claude Mockels ou l'équipe de recrutement – Stéphanie Piron. Nous avons hâte d'avoir de vos nouvelles! Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison). Activités significatives : Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes - Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client. - Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire. - Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres. - Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres. Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication - Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité. - Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP). - Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur. Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire - Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur. - Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …). - Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs. - Vérification des documents qualité interne. - Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités. - Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration. Après la livraison client - Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI). - Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties. Compétences requises : Compétences métier – technique
• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)
• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).
• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)
• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.
• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies
• IWE classique (soudure)
• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection
• Anglais courant Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire
• Maîtrise du code RCCM
• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)
• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)
• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon What we offer you
• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe
• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER
• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe
• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)
• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

Activités significatives : Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes - Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client. - Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire. - Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres. - Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres. Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication - Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité. - Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP). - Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur. Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire - Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur. - Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …). - Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs. - Vérification des documents qualité interne. - Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités. - Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration. Après la livraison client - Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI). - Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties. Compétences requises : Compétences métier – technique

• IWE classique (soudure)
• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Maîtrise du code RCCM
• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)
• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)
• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget . Key Responsibilities:
• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.
• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.
• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.
• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.
• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.
• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.
• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.
• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).
• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.
• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).
• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time
• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets. Preferred Assets:
• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.
• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.
• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed). What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Proporcionar diagnóstico, asistencia técnica, entrenamiento y servicios de mantenimiento para bombas y equipos relacionados en las instalaciones del cliente. El candidato puede estar basado en Lima o Arequipa. Funciones básicas
• Realizar la instalación, puesta en marcha y arranque de bombas y equipos asociados en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y las inspecciones de las bombas para garantizar un desempeño y una fiabilidad óptimos.
• Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas mecánicos, eléctricos y del sistema de control con bombas y componentes relacionados.
• Utilizar documentación técnica, esquemas y herramientas de diagnóstico para identificar y resolver problemas de forma eficaz.
• Coordinarse con los clientes para programar visitas de servicio, comunicar actualizaciones de proyectos y abordar cualquier duda o pregunta.
• Proporcionar formación y asistencia in situ a los clientes sobre el funcionamiento correcto y los procedimientos de mantenimiento de las bombas.
• Colaborar con los equipos internos para escalar y resolver problemas técnicos complejos según sea necesario.
• Documentar las actividades de servicio, incluidas las tareas de mantenimiento, el uso de piezas y las interacciones con los clientes, de forma clara y organizada.
• Cumplir los protocolos de seguridad y las políticas de la empresa mientras se trabaja en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Actuar como enlace entre los clientes y la empresa para garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción del cliente.
• Proveer de entrenamiento a los clientes en el mantenimiento y operación de las bombas
• Documentar oportunidades de desarrollo de servicios dentro de las cuentas clave de la compañía Condiciones de trabajo
• Este puesto requiere viajar con frecuencia a las instalaciones de los clientes, lo que puede implicar la exposición a diversas condiciones ambientales y exigencias físicas.
• Los ingenieros de servicio de campo pueden tener que trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluidas noches y fines de semana, para adaptarse a los horarios de los clientes y a las solicitudes de servicio urgentes Requisitos
• Licenciatura o experiencia equivalente en ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería electromecánica, ingeniería eléctrica o un campo relacionado.
• Inglés intermedio o avanzado, requerido.
• Experiencia demostrada trabajando con bombas, preferiblemente en un servicio de campo o mantenimiento.
• Conocimientos sólidos de principios mecánicos, dinámica de fluidos y sistemas eléctricos.
• Dominio de la localización y reparación de averías en equipos mecánicos y eléctricos.
• Excelentes dotes de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita, con capacidad para interactuar profesionalmente con clientes y compañeros.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y gestionar el tiempo eficazmente a fin de cumplir los plazos de servicio.
• Disponibilidad para viajar a las instalaciones de los clientes cuando sea necesario, a veces con poca antelación.
• Permiso de conducir válido y un historial de conducción limpio.
• Fuerte compromiso con la seguridad y cumplimiento de las directrices de seguridad.
• Se valorarán las certificaciones en mantenimiento de bombas o campos técnicos pertinentes.
• La e xperiencia con clientes mineros de la Zona Sur de Perú es un plus.
• Aptitud del Anexo 16 y Anexo 16A .
• Tener una certificación PMI o conocimiento probado en gestión de proyectos es un plus What we offer you Annual bonus Health Insurance Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges. This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的: Purpose of the Job: This position is part of the Engineering department. As a Structural Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.). Structural Engineer reports to Engineering Manager. 主要任务与职责: Main tasks and responsibilities:
• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids.
• Calculation of main metal structures of skids
• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline
• Material selection within discipline
• Value engineering within discipline
• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.
• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities
• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.
• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline
• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.
• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.
• Tracking and managing changes within discipline. 职位要求： Qualifications: Education and Experience
• Bachelor in Civil Structure Engineering
• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.
• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)
• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.
• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction. Language
• Fluent in Mandarin and English Others
• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.
• Ability to work in multiple projects.
• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning. What we offer you target bonus：18.33% of annual income Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Mansioni Job Summary Il Production Planner è responsabile della pianificazione e del coordinamento delle attività di produzione per garantire la consegna tempestiva dei prodotti. Questo ruolo lavora a stretto contatto con l'acquisto, la produzione e la logistica per allineare i piani di produzione con le previsioni della domanda e la disponibilità delle risorse. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano conoscenze pratiche di un'area lavorativa e lavorano in modo autonomo con supervisione generale. Compiti chiave:
• Sviluppare e mantenere i piani di produzione principali in base ai target di vendita, agli ordini dei clienti e alle previsioni della domanda.
• Analizzare la capacità di produzione, il carico di lavoro e l'utilizzo delle risorse (lavoro, attrezzature) per identificare vincoli e collo di bottiglia.
• Collaborare con il team di produzione, ingegneria e acquisto per risolvere i conflitti di pianificazione e attuare azioni correttive.
• Monitorare i progressi del piano principale e regolare i piani in modo proattivo per raggiungere l'obiettivo di vendita.
• mantenere i dati di pianificazione accurati, la documentazione e generare rapporti di prestazione regolari (ad esempio, aderenza al piano, utilizzo della capacità).
• Migliorare continuamente i processi di pianificazione per aumentare l'efficienza, ridurre i tempi di consegna e supportare le iniziative di produzione snella. Requisiti Competenze e qualifiche: Tipicamente è richiesto un titolo di laurea (o esperienza lavorativa equivalente) e almeno 3-4 anni di esperienza pertinente (o competenze equivalenti) per svolgere il ruolo. Competenze analitiche e organizzative. Esperienza con i sistemi ERP/MRP. Conoscenza della pianificazione e programmazione principale. Abilità comunicativa e di collaborazione efficace. Capacità di gestione di più priorità. Cosa offriamo bonus target: 16,67% del reddito annuale Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e siamo impegnati a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere stati riconosciuti come miglior datore di lavoro 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:
• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.
• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.
• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.
• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.
• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).
• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives. Skills & Qualifications: Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role. Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities. What we offer you target bonus: 16.67% of annual income Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Mansioni Job Summary Der Produktionsplaner ist verantwortlich für die Leitung und Koordination der Produktionsaktivitäten, um die Kontrolle über die stürmischen Produkte zu gewährleisten. Dieser Ruolo hat sich mit der Auftragsabwicklung, der Produktion und der Logistik in Verbindung gesetzt, um alle Produktionsschritte mit den Hausvoraussetzungen und der Risikobereitschaft zu erledigen. Dieses Arbeitsprofil ist für einen erfahrenen Fachmann bestimmt, der sich mit der Praxis eines Arbeitsgebiets auskennt und unter allgemeiner Aufsicht autonom arbeitet. Wettbewerbsvorteile:
• Betreuung und Wartung der Hauptproduktionsmitarbeiter auf der Basis des Verkaufsziels, Bestellung der Kunden und alle Vorabbestimmungen für das Haus.
• Analysieren Sie die Produktionskapazität, den Arbeitsaufwand und die Nutzung des Risikos (Arbeit, Attraktivität) zur Identifizierung von Wein und Flaschenabfüllung.
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Produktions-, Ingenieur- und Akquiseteam zusammen, um Konstruktionskonflikte zu lösen und technische Korrekturen vorzunehmen.
• Überwachen Sie den Fortschritt des Klaviers und regulieren Sie die Klaviere sorgfältig, um das Verkaufsziel zu erreichen.
• Pflegen Sie die genauen Klavierdaten, dokumentieren Sie sie und erstellen Sie Berichte über die reguläre Aufführung (z. B. Klavier, Klavierauslastung, Kapazitätsauslastung).
• Kontinuierliche Klavierbearbeitungsprozesse werden verbessert, um die Effizienz zu steigern, Auftragsabläufe zu reduzieren und schnelle Produktionsinitiativen zu unterstützen. Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen: Sie verfügen über einen Abschlusstitel (oder eine gleichwertige Berufserfahrung) und mindestens 3-4 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung (oder eine gleichwertige Kompetenz) für die Dauer des Studiums. Analytische und organisatorische Kompetenz. Erfahrung mit ERP/MRP-Systemen. Klavier- und Hauptprogrammierung. Kommunikationsfähigkeit und effektive Zusammenarbeit. Die Kapazität hat höchste Priorität. Der angebotene Zielbonus: 16,67 % des jährlichen Sulzer-Bonus ist ein Arbeitgeber, der bei gleicher Gelegenheit gearbeitet hat. Vertrauen in die Stärke einer vielfältigen Arbeitsintensität und die Schaffung einer inklusiven Arbeitsatmosphäre. Diese Organisationen haben am 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten neue Staaten gegründet.

Mansioni Job Summary Le Planificateur de Production est responsable de la planification et de la coordination des activités de production afin de garantir la tempête des produits. Celui-ci travaillera à un contact direct avec l'acquisition, la production et la logistique pour les lignes et les plans de production avec la prévision de la propriété et la disponibilité des risques. Ce profil de travail est destiné à des professionnels experts qui connaissent la pratique d'une zone de travail et travaillent en mode autonome avec supervision générale. Compiti chiave:
• Stabiliser et entretenir les principaux plans de production en fonction des objectifs de vente, des commandes des clients et de toutes les prévisions de la propriété.
• Analyser la capacité de production, le chargement du travail et l'utilisation des ressources (travail, attrezzature) pour identifier les vins et les bouteilles de vin.
• Collaborer avec l'équipe de production, les ingénieurs et les acquis pour résoudre les conflits de planification et mettre en œuvre des solutions correctives.
• Surveillez la progression du piano principal et réglez le piano de manière proactive pour augmenter l'objectif de vente.
• Conserver les données de planification précises, la documentation et générer des rapports d'exécution réguliers (à titre d'exemple, d'adéquation au piano, d'utilisation de la capacité).
• Améliorer continuellement les processus de planification pour augmenter l'efficacité, réduire les délais de consommation et soutenir les initiatives de production snella. Compétences et qualifications requises : Généralement, il possède un titre de lauréat (une expérience professionnelle équivalente) et au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience pertinente (ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente) pour gagner le travail. Compétence analytique et organisationnelle. Expérience avec le système ERP/MRP. Connaissance de la planification et de la programmation principale. Capacité de communication et de collaboration efficace. Capacité de gestion de plus grande priorité. Nous offrons un bonus cible : 16,67 % du compte annuel Sulzer est un dateur de travail par opportunité. Nous avons confiance en la force d'un travail diversifié et nous nous imprégnons d'offrir une ambiance de travail inclusive. Nous avons organisé des statistiques sur la meilleure date de travail 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, dans le Royaume-Uni et dans les États-Unis.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group IT Engineering Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining software and cloud-based applications, ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role supports project delivery and contributes to technical innovation. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the Job (summarized) To ensure the continued development and support of Application Integration portfolio within the business organisation. Ensuring that the business is kept at an efficient, functioning state regarding its integrated applications applications / processes. We need Integration Developer in our Sales Tools team, reporting to the AGM Sales Tools, Global Delivery Center within the Global IT Team. We are looking for a self-driven. Integration Developer Your job General Tasks:
• Develop and maintain Application Integration solutions (real-time / batch)
• Supporting and maintaining integration solutions and related components e.g. databases, queues
• Designing and modelling of databases, tables, stored procedures according to solution requirement
• Create / configure / fine tune / monitoring queues (MSMQ, Azure Service Bus queue, ActiveMQ)
• Scheduling and deployment
• Coordinate with different teams for fixing integration issues / new implementations
• Talend monitoring
• Monitoring, fixing non-working and broken jobs
• Monitoring the health of Talend remote engine / run-time servers. Give suggestions accordingly.
• Talend infrastructure; keeping Talend infrastructure up to date according to predefined schedule
• Patching, upgrades, deployment, etc.
• Debugging and optimizing implementations Technical:
• Experience with (a) modern integration platform(s).
• Should be well-versed with SQL (database designing, create tables, stored procedures)

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities: - Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses. - Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors. - Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications. - Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities. - Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment. - Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities. - Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions. - Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation. - Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations. - Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability. Required Qualifications: - High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred. - Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment. - Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits. - Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation. - Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment. - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. - Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages. - Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems. - OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems. - Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices. Physical Requirements: - Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions. - Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks. - Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces. Work Environment: - Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations. - May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations. Key Competencies: - Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills - Attention to detail and safety awareness - Strong communication and teamwork - Self-motivated with the ability to work independently What we offer you

About the role Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.
• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.
• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.
• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).
• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.
• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.
• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.
• Must supply basic personal hand tools. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.
• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

Hai fatto qualcosa per lavorare e lavorare in anticipo nella carriera e hai visto cosa funziona effettivamente nella pratica – non solo sulla carta. Ma non sei solo esperto della tecnica. Sei un dio nel pianificare la legge, come combinare se stessi con lo samarbeide e padroneggiare le attività digitali come una delle cose naturali di ogni giorno.
